data.translation: We bought a kilogram of … yogurt and four-five pieces of bread, and we would spread it on it, and they would said, ‘For goodness’ sake, Daddy-o, eat!’

rationale: First Infectum-wa box; spreading yoghurt is an extension of existing einreiben/coating, not a separate sense.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (JTM 1.5/16)

data.turoyo: Məd šaḥən, gəmḥalqət u našadərayḏe aʕle, w bəṯr məd mḥalaqwolux u našadər, gmoḥət u darmono, gfošər, gmaydət u kətonayḏux, gfurxatle bi kefo di gurəsto, w gməḥatle bu sfoqo, u kətonawo.
data.translation: Wenn es heiß geworden ist, streust du den năšadir darauf, und wenn du den năšadir darauf gestreut hast, gibst du das Verzinnungsmittel darauf, es schmilzt, du nimmst deine Baumwolle, reibst sie am Stein der Handmühle, und dann reibst du mit dieser Baumwolle das Geschirrstück.

rationale: Thin Infectum cell; technical rubbing with cotton and a millstone, not a distinct technical sense.

summary: The corpus distinguishes rubbing a body/surface, crumbling material and applying a coating; all are already included in the inherited composite gloss. Magical activation of a ring does not make German drehen a separate Turoyo meaning.
Body-part objects are often possessed NPs (lebe, ḥaṣi, ʕayne); overt l-marked agents occur with -la/-le. Reflexive ruḥi at 52/134 remains active, not Detransitive.
Infectum-wa is securely attested in two MAC accounts of repeated food preparation and vessel finishing. Unprefixed deliberative Infectum at JTM 4.5/13 must not be relabelled from the German question.
The inherited Detransitive Part. Pass. describes crumbled bread. Its previously missing sense list is made explicit; D1 is a reader label, not an existing glossary number.
PrS 1/46, 39/89 and 71/39 parallel inherited quotations under prs 4/11, 107/34 and 202/7. Reference concordance needs checking before changing any citation.
No distinct light-verb idiom was established: massaging lebe and rubbing rings are literal objects.
99/65 has a supplied alignment warning: its German adds an admonition absent from this verse. Verify the edition boundary before quotation.
PrS 18/49: confirm lfərxo and whether l- is a printed error or a different prefixed construction; no spelling is normalized.
Confirm the Imperativ vocalism frax at JTM 4.5/13.
Check the PrS reference concordance before altering the inherited ring, chest-massage and bread citations.
Food can be spread onto bread; the b-marked surface is compatible with ordinary rubbing/coating.
Magical smoke and human opponents serve as objects of rubbing or crushing without establishing new lexical senses.
